"""A small CLI whose release metadata is used to qualify a real version-bump run."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from collections.abc import Sequence
from pathlib import Path


def add(left: int, right: int) -> int:
    """Add two integers."""
    return left + right


def release_version() -> str:
    """Read the canonical release metadata."""
    return Path(__file__).with_name("VERSION").read_text().strip()


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    """Run the addition CLI or print its release version."""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--version", action="version", version=release_version())
    parser.add_argument("left", type=int)
    parser.add_argument("right", type=int)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    print(add(args.left, args.right))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
